questions.question: In your healthcare support roles, how did you gather input from clinical, billing, clerical, and executive users when improving or supporting systems such as Mindlinc and IMA?
Describe the QA testing you performed during the migration of the Electronic Health Record and billing systems to Montefiore. How did you define test scenarios, document results, and handle defects?

This role requires Salesforce Business Analyst experience with Lightning, Sales Cloud, and Service Cloud. What exposure, if any, have you had to Salesforce, and how would you apply your healthcare systems background to learning these products?
Walk me through a technology migration you supported, from identifying user and system requirements through cutover, validation, and post-migration support.
How did you translate technical issues or system constraints into clear communication for clinical and administrative stakeholders at the health centers?

Give an example of a recurring workflow issue involving registration, billing, EHR usage, or access management that you identified. What evidence did you use, and what improvement did you recommend or implement?
What documentation did you create or maintain for application support, user access, infrastructure changes, testing, or disaster recovery, and how did it support operational continuity?

Describe how you collaborated with external vendors to maintain or improve EHR, billing, and backup applications. How did you communicate requirements, prioritize issues, and confirm that solutions met user needs?
The position requires Jira and Jira Align. What experience do you have using Jira, Jira Align, or comparable tools to track requirements, defects, service requests, testing, or project work?
How would you approach analyzing Salesforce data to identify trends in a life-sciences business process and present actionable findings to business stakeholders?
